chunks: 1357 - Saʿd al-Iskāf narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"Whoever says these words, I guarantee that no scorpion or harmful creature will afflict him until morning:

I seek refuge in the complete words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of what He has brought forth, and from the evil of every creature
"whose forelock He holds. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path."

key_terms.بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ: through the perfect and complete words of Allah
key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ: a straight path, indicating perfect justice and order
key_terms.نَاصِيَتِهَا: its forelock, signifying complete control over it
key_terms.هَامَّةٌ: a harmful creeping creature or venomous being

ai.seo_question: What du'a should be recited before sleep for protection from scorpions and harmful creatures?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a protective supplication to be recited before sleep, seeking refuge in the perfect words of Allah from harmful creatures and created evils. It closes with a Qur'anic phrase affirming Allah’s complete dominion and perfect justice.
